articles.title: Trump’s AG Pick Caves to Republican Rebels in Major Climbdown
articles.description: Win McNamee / Win McNamee/Getty Images Donald Trump’s pick for attorney general says he is terminating the president’s $1.8 billion Jan. 6 slush fund in a dramatic capitulation to two Republican senators threatening to block his nomination. Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche, Trump’s former personal lawyer, announced in an X post late Sunday night that the Anti-Weaponization Fund—designed to compensate Trump allies and even participants in the 2021 Capitol riots—had been “rescinded.” The move could secure the votes of rogue Republican senators Thom Tillis and John Cornyn, who were blocking Blanche’s nomination to become attorney general. Tillis called the fund Trump’s “payout pot for punks.” Read more at The Daily Beast.
